cards.consumerAndFactSource: Life.step/stepEntity consume existing World facts; C2 gates skill maintenance and B2 calls nearestSeekSite only in the existing planNext roll<0.42 branch.
cards.settlementObjects: Life traverses the same entity list. Skill maintenance is eligible for level>0, existing combat, or explicit skills. Each seek query scans current world.sites once.
cards.timePrecision: One Life.step call per existing advance; optional dt bucket records that call's dtDays; eligibility is checked at the existing per-entity point.
cards.worstCaseCost: Life remains O(N). C2 eligibility is O(1); B2 is one O(S) sites pass with inclusive radius-30 checks and prospective cave content validation. No sorting, candidate array, or index. Life timers remain nested: stepEntity within entity-loop; advance life wraps Life.step.
cards.queryMethod: Existing Life entity array and direct profile fields; diagnostics use direct counters only.
cards.rngContract: C2 eligibility and B2 selector draw no RNG; original roll<0.42 gate remains. Filtering can find a farther valid target where old nearest formation/empty cave prevented seeking, changing whether the existing duration draw runs and thus later Life.rng trajectory. This is deliberate B behavior, not baseline RNG equivalence.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache. Eligibility reads current profile; site search reads current positions, kind/content, and artifact ownership.
cards.dataLifetime: No new search save fields. C2 may omit default empty skills/combat for unqualified profiles; B2 stores its chosen destination through existing plan state.
cards.failureAndExit: Candidate is not a route reachability proof; planNext does no pathfinding. Existing stale-target/arrival behavior remains.
cards.testEvidence: Controlled C2 eligibility/save fixtures and same-version metrics equivalence. B2 controlled Life.planNext fixture covers excluded empty cave/formation, selected valid nearby site and draw boundary. 100-year A/B passed per implementation report; 400-year pending separately.

cards.queryMethod: Existing subsystem entry points; metrics use direct WeakMap lookup.
cards.rngContract: Life timing adds no RNG; phase order, stream ownership and ordering unchanged.
cards.dataLifetime: World metrics remain opt-in WeakMap state, excluded from saves.

cards.testEvidence: Enabled/disabled complete world and all registered RNG digest equal on a 30-day paired run; separate 100/400-year diagnostics runs are reported as measurement evidence.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: stepSkillResources reads/updates existing Wanxiang practice/combat/resource state. Optional world argument only enables diagnostics. C1 updateCombatResources does default-skill setup, one capacity read, allocation/clamp, then regeneration. C2 needsSkillResources is a pure O(1) predicate over level, existing combat, and explicit skill slots.
cards.settlementObjects: Life calls maintenance only for profiles with level>0, existing combat state, or a non-empty explicit skill list. Direct stepSkillResources calls repeat the predicate guard; retained legacy state remains eligible.
cards.timePrecision: Existing entity step; no new invocation or scheduling.
cards.worstCaseCost: Eligible update retains bounded per-entity practice/effect/resource work; C1 performs one manaCapacity evaluation. B gate is O(1), and rejected profiles avoid practiceState/default skills/combat allocation and regeneration. Metrics are opt-in O(1). Capacity counter is only for stepSkillResources/combatState calls receiving world, not all global capacity calls.
cards.queryMethod: Direct entity reference and current cultivation/practice fields.
cards.rngContract: The third world argument enables diagnostics only. Predicate, C1 capacity dedup, and resource maintenance draw no RNG. C2 changes whether default empty combat state is created for an unqualified profile; future content granting mana/devour/other resource semantics to level-zero entities must extend eligibility before relying on this maintenance path.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache; predicate and capacity read current level/skills/combat/physique every call.
cards.dataLifetime: Existing combat/skills save payload is preserved when present. C2 stops creating default skill/combat fields for ineligible profiles; save shape therefore intentionally differs from baseline for those profiles, with no schema/version change.
cards.failureAndExit: Invalid/nonpositive dt exits as before. A zero-level entity with combat or explicit skills remains maintained; injury, possession, identity/plane, or level loss do not erase retained state. A zero-level profile with none of these is skipped.
cards.testEvidence: C1 --capacity-only asserts one capacity read per eligible update. C2 controlled tests cover empty mortals 30/360 days, legacy combat, explicit skills, formal awakening, identity/injury/plane, death cleanup, and v11 restore. Same-version metrics on/off equivalence passes. Original-baseline B replay is not asserted bitwise; output may differ by omitted default payload and future world-line consequences.

cards.riskClass: B: nearest eligible target may differ from old nearest raw site, changing duration draw and subsequent Life.rng trajectory.
cards.consumerAndFactSource: Implemented nearestSeekSite, called only from the existing planNext roll<0.42 branch. Reads world.sites and uses siteHasContent for prospective caves; arrival/rewards remain existing consumers.
cards.settlementObjects: One planning actor; one traversal of world.sites. Excludes formations and caves with siteHasContent=false. Secret realms, ruins and other kinds remain eligible for generic rewards. No extra actor-level or route qualification.
cards.timePrecision: Only when planNext reselects a destination; not every frame or simulation step.
cards.worstCaseCost: O(S) scan plus siteHasContent checks for prospective cave candidates within the current radius-30 best set; content validation may inspect artifact ownership. No hard candidate cap, history scan, persistent index, sort, or candidate array. Metrics-off path does not time or allocate candidates. Metrics-on nearest-* diagnostics perform one extra read-only check of raw nearest; this may be a dormant cave and does not describe the selected target.
cards.queryMethod: Single pass over world.sites with squared-distance radius/pre-pruning; sqrt only as needed. Exact ties keep array order, matching the previous stable sitesNear sort. No spatial index.
cards.rngContract: Selector consumes no RNG. Existing seek roll remains. Filtering may now select a farther valid site when the old nearest formation/empty cave blocked seeking; the existing duration draw then occurs, changing future Life.rng trajectory. Controlled fixture draw counts do not imply all-worldline equality.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache; every call reads current site position/content and artifact ownership.
cards.dataLifetime: No new persistent search state; existing plan state retains selected destination.
cards.failureAndExit: Inclusive radius 30. Candidate does not prove reachability; current planning does not pathfind. No new cancellation protocol.
cards.testEvidence: Controlled tests cover empty/content cave, secret/ruin generic rewards, radius, stable array-order ties, fresh content after claim/exhaustion, and Life.planNext draw boundary. 100-year A/B passed per implementation report; 400-year still pending. seek.checked counts all sites; content-checks only prospective candidates; nearest-* describes raw nearest and includes its extra read-only diagnostic check.
